title: Improve purchase journey/top-up flow for ON Live
card_note: Finding room to improve for product
actions: I owned the change of ON Live's virtual currency from GEM to "Đá quý" (Gems) across the App and Web: converting every user's balance, restructuring the top-up packages & purchase journey, removing OnG as also a visible & intermediary payment method for buying GEM, and adding an implicit flow that lets users spend OnG to send gifts.
results: Standardize on 1 primary currency, with the other currency's process run implicitly, change the top-up rate without any balance discrepancy on any account
Shorten the path from "not enough Gems" to "gift sent"
Shorten the purchase journey on Web to increase top-up conversion
body:
**Background**

ON Live runs 2 virtual currencies (GEM and OnG) for several service (donating, voting, buying sticker,...) with top-up and spend flows spread across the App and Web. The conversion rates result in fractional amounts because previous top-up packages were designed primarily for the internal business’s convenience. Furthermore, transaction details and top-up journey are quite difficult to track and understand as a whole. We have received this feedback from users during the initial period following the product's relaunch.

**Problems**

- 2 different virtual currencies, prices and payment methods differed between App and Web, which in general was hard for users to fully understand, manage and was easy to confuse.
- Users who had OnG but not enough Gems could not send a gift right away and had to leave the live session to proceed to the next steps
- The payment UI needed to be clearer about prices and terms and to simplify processing

**Goals**

1. Standardize on 1 primary currency, with the other currency's process run implicitly, change the top-up rate without any balance discrepancy on any account
2. Shorten the path from "not enough Gems" to "gift sent"
3. Shorten the purchase journey on Web to increase top-up conversion.

**Update overview**

| Item | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Product | ON Live, a livestreaming platform where viewers top up and gift Gems and streamers receive them |
| Role | Product Manager: coordinate with BA to write the SRS, define business flows, mockups, system rules and the scope of each phase |
| Platforms | Mobile App (payments via Google Play/App Store IAP) \n\n Website (QR bank transfer, e-wallets, payment gateways) |
| Timeline | \~6 weeks (Created 18 May, updated through 2 July) |
| Scope | Rename GEM to "Đá quý" (Gems), excluding the portal, convert balances, restructure top-up packages, remove OnG as a way to buy Gems, allow OnG to be used for gifting, redesign the payment UI |
| Deliverables | 2 SRS documents (App, Web) covering all use cases, business flow diagrams, detailed mockups for every case, and Figma links |
| Team | IT team (Devs, QA, Designers, BAs, Marketing) and Business team (Product) members involved |

###### Document Heads:

- Solution
- Key business logic
- Product decisions, risks and mitigations
- Timeline Management (including document versions)
- Result & lesson learned
